newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian man loses family in roof collapse.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian man loses family in roof collapse.

text.p: A man lost his entire family of four on Tuesday when their roof collapsed in Cairo's twin city of Giza, but escaped himself because he had moved out to make room for his visiting sister who also died, security sources said.
The man's wife, two daughters aged seven and five, and a 10-month-old son were killed along with his sister while they slept, they said.
The man was sleeping outside the upper-floor room because there was no space for him inside after his sister came to visit, they added.
